Author: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>
Date:   Tue Jul 21 01:58:45 2026 -0700

    phonet: pep: fix use-after-free in pep_get_sb()
    
    pep_get_sb() doesn't consider that pskb_may_pull() might have relocated
    the skb data, and continue to access the older pointer, causing UAF.
    
    Reproduced under KASAN:
    
      BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in pep_get_sb+0x234/0x3b0

       phonet_rcv+0x5b3/0x6c0
       __netif_receive_skb+0xcc/0x1d0
    
    Refetch the header with skb_header_pointer() after pskb_may_pull(), so
    the possibly stale pointer is no longer dereferenced. There are better
    ways to solve this, but, this is the less instrusive one.
    
    Fixes: 9641458d3ec4 ("Phonet: Pipe End Point for Phonet Pipes protocol")
    Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
    Signed-off-by: Breno Leitao <leitao@debian.org>

    Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/phonet/pep.c b/net/phonet/pep.c
index 706927139393..31b29e3ca7bc 100644
--- a/net/phonet/pep.c
+++ b/net/phonet/pep.c
@@ -55,6 +55,8 @@ static unsigned char *pep_get_sb(struct sk_buff *skb, u8 *ptype, u8 *plen,
 	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);
 	if (ph == NULL || ph->sb_len < 2 || !pskb_may_pull(skb, ph->sb_len))

+	/* pskb_may_pull() may have reallocated the head; refetch ph. */
+	ph = skb_header_pointer(skb, 0, 2, &h);

 	*ptype = ph->sb_type;
 	*plen = ph->sb_len;

cat > "$TMPDIR/null_miss2.py" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Broader: for each skb_header_pointer call, print call + 8 following lines; flag
# assignments to struct member targets (x->y = skb_header_pointer...) and array/elem derefs.
import re, subprocess, sys
paths = subprocess.run(["grep","-rln","skb_header_pointer","net/","drivers/net/","--include=*.c"],
                       capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()
callre=re.compile(r'(__)?skb_header_pointer(_with_crop)?\s*\(')
for p in paths:
    lines=open(p,errors="replace").read().split("\n")
    for i,l in enumerate(lines):
        if callre.search(l):
            # resolve var incl. member targets like ctx->optp
            pre=l.split("skb_header_pointer")[0]
            m=re.search(r'([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*(?:->[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*|\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*)*)\s*=\s*$', pre)
            var=m.group(1) if m else None
            j=i
            while j<len(lines) and not re.search(r';\s*$', "\n".join(lines[i:j+1]).split("skb_header_pointer",1)[1] if "skb_header_pointer" in lines[i] else lines[j]):
                j+=1
                if j>i+4: break
            w="\n".join(lines[j:j+8])
            prev="\n".join(lines[max(0,i-3):i])
            if var:
                # count derefs after
                base=var.split("->")[0].split(".")[0]
                nullchk=re.compile(r'(\bif\s*\(\s*!'+re.escape(var)+r'\b|\b'+re.escape(var)+r'\s*(?:==|!=)\s*NULL)')
                if not (nullchk.search(w) or nullchk.search(prev)):
                    print(f"--- {p}:{i+1} var={var}")
                    print("\n".join(lines[i:min(len(lines),i+9)]))
EOF
python3 "$TMPDIR/null_miss2.py" > "$TMPDIR/null_miss2.txt" 2>&1; grep -c '^---' "$TMPDIR/null_miss2.txt"; grep '^---' "$TMPDIR/null_miss2.txt"
input.description: Broader NULL-check miss scan with member targets
